cases.quote: فهذا مثال مصلحة غير مأخوذة بطريق القياس على أصل معين.
cases.note: Candidate source-author reading only, not a reviewed ruling or normative stance selection. The hypothetical assumes that refraining from striking the shield leads to the destruction of all Muslims, including the captives. The stated purpose is reducing otherwise unavoidable loss; the particular means lacks a specific analogical precedent. The modeled true value for certainty covers certainty or near-certainty (p177), not ordinary probability. At p177 al-Ghazālī expressly leaves the issue within ijtihad and allows the possibility of prohibition. The positive guard evaluates the formal reading; it does not establish a reviewed authorial ruling.
